PepGen also released today positive topline results from the 10 mg/kg multiple ascending dose cohort of the ongoing Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 trial ( NCT06667453 ) evaluating PGN-EDODM1 in patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1), a rare, progressive, and multisystemic genetic disease.

“We are very confident in PGN-EDODM1’s potential to deliver meaningful benefit to the DM1 community, and our company ended the quarter in a strong position to advance the program to the third and highest dose cohort, which is fully enrolled.” Recent Program Updates PGN-EDODM1: Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 (DM1) • FREEDOM2-DM1 Phase 2 Multiple Ascending Dose (MAD) 10 mg/kg Results: o Topline data from the 10 mg/kg dose cohort demonstrated a mean splicing correction of 46.5%, the highest reported to date in a multiple dose study.

The 12.5 mg/kg cohort of FREEDOM2 is fully enrolled with all participants having received up to three doses and results are expected in the first half of 2027. o The DSMB also approved dose escalation in the OLE from 5 mg/kg to 10 mg/kg.

Interim 10 mg/kg OLE safety and 5 mg/kg OLE clinical data are expected in January 2027. o Building upon the positive results seen at 10 mg/kg, PepGen plans to initiate an expansion cohort, running in parallel to Cohort 3, to generate longer term (up to 9 months) data.
